adb_enabled: Enables or disables the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for USB debugging.
development_settings_enabled: Activates the Developer options menu for advanced settings.
window_animation_scale: Controls the speed of window transition animations.
transition_animation_scale: Controls the speed of activity transition animations.
animator_duration_scale: Controls the duration of animation effects throughout the UI.
peak_refresh_rate: Sets the maximum screen refresh rate supported by the display.
display_density: Defines the pixel density (DPI) used for scaling UI elements.
font_scale: Adjusts the overall system font size scaling factor.
lockscreen_sounds_enabled: Turns lock screen sounds (e.g., notification chime) on or off.
charging_sounds_enabled: Enables or disables the sound played when the device starts charging.
charging_sounds_max_volume: Sets the maximum volume level for charging sounds.
adaptive_charging_enabled: Enables adaptive charging to prolong battery lifespan.
battery_saver_enabled: Activates Battery Saver mode to reduce power consumption.
low_power_mode: Enables low power mode for extended battery life.
screen_off_timeout: Specifies the inactivity duration before the screen turns off.
screen_brightness_mode: Sets automatic (1) or manual (0) brightness control.
auto_rotate: Enables or disables automatic screen rotation based on device orientation.
accelerometer_rotation: Allows rotation using the accelerometer sensor.
stay_on_while_plugged_in: Keeps the screen on while the device is charging.
sleep_timeout: Defines the duration before the device enters sleep mode.
privacy_guard_enabled: Enables privacy guard to limit app access to sensitive data.
lock_screen_allow_private_notifications: Shows or hides private content in lock screen notifications.
lock_screen_show_notifications: Shows or hides all notifications on the lock screen.
lock_screen_secure: Requires a PIN, pattern, or password to unlock the device.
lock_screen_owner_info: Displays custom owner information on the lock screen.
install_non_market_apps: Allows installation of apps from unknown sources.
show_non_trebuchet_apps: Shows apps that are not part of the main launcher.
default_input_method: Specifies the default keyboard input method.
default_sms_application: Sets the default SMS app used for messaging.
default_dialer_application: Sets the default dialer app for making calls.
default_browser: Specifies the default web browser for opening links.
default_assistant: Sets the default Assistant app (e.g., Google Assistant).
global_action_dialog_visible: Shows or hides the global actions menu (power menu).
camera_double_tap_power_gesture_disabled: Disables the double‑tap power button shortcut for launching the camera.
camera_launch_gesture_disabled: Disables the camera launch gesture from the lock screen.
quick_settings_tiles: Customizes the set of Quick Settings tiles displayed when pulling down the notification shade.
expanded_desktop_enabled: Enables expanded desktop mode, hiding the status bar for a fullscreen experience.
immersive_mode_enabled: Keeps navigation and status bars hidden for immersive content.
notification_dots_enabled: Shows notification dots on app icons for unread alerts.
night_display_activated: Activates Night Light (blue‑light filter) for reduced eye strain.
night_display_auto_mode: Enables automatic scheduling for Night Light based on sunset/sunrise.
night_display_color_temperature: Adjusts the color temperature for Night Light.
doze_enabled: Enables Doze mode to restrict background activity when the device is idle.
doze_light_mode_enabled: Enables a lighter version of Doze that still allows limited background tasks.
doze_pulse_enabled: Allows periodic background processing while in Doze.
wifi_scan_always_enabled: Keeps Wi‑Fi scanning active even when Wi‑Fi is turned off.
wifi_sleep_policy: Controls Wi‑Fi behavior during device sleep (e.g., never, during sleep, never when plugged).
bluetooth_discoverable: Makes the device discoverable to other Bluetooth devices.
airplane_mode_on: Turns Airplane mode on or off, disabling all radios.
mobile_data: Enables or disables cellular data connectivity.
preferred_network_mode: Specifies the preferred cellular network type (e.g., LTE, 3G).
location_mode: Sets the location accuracy mode (high accuracy, battery saving, sensors only).
gps_enabled: Enables or disables GPS satellite positioning.
network_location_enabled: Enables or disables location via Wi‑Fi and cellular networks.
auto_time: Synchronizes device time automatically with network time.
auto_time_zone: Synchronizes device time zone automatically with network time.
screen_security_enabled: Requires authentication before showing the screen content after sleep.
screen_lock_timeout: Specifies the duration before the screen lock engages after waking.
keyguard_secure: Enforces a secure lock screen (PIN, pattern, password).
unlock_method_securely: Controls whether biometric unlock requires a secure credential fallback.
fingerprint_vibration_enabled: Provides haptic feedback on successful fingerprint authentication.
face_unlock_enabled: Enables facial recognition for unlocking the device.
secure_lock_screen_owner_info_enabled: Shows owner info on the secure lock screen.
notification_vibration_intensity: Sets the strength of vibration for notifications.
ambient_display_enabled: Shows ambient display (always‑on screen) for notifications.
always_on_vpn: Keeps VPN connection active at all times.
default_vpn: Specifies the default VPN app to use for connections.
usb_mass_storage_enabled: Enables USB mass storage mode for file transfer.
usb_mtp_enabled: Enables Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) for USB connections.
usb_ptp_enabled: Enables Picture Transfer Protocol (PTP) for USB connections.
debug_app_package: Specifies a package to be treated as a debug app (allows debugging without user interaction).
debug_view_attributes: Shows view attribute overlays on the screen for debugging UI layouts.
show_touches: Displays visual feedback for touch events on the screen.
window_animation_scale_pixel: Pixel‑level control of window animation scaling (OEM-specific).
roaming_enabled: Allows data roaming while on a cellular network.
network_reset: Resets all network settings to default values.
default_input_method_subtype: Specifies the default keyboard language/keyboard layout.
auto_update_security_patches: Enables automatic installation of security patches.
device_name: Sets the Bluetooth device name visible to other devices.
default_media_projection_package: Specifies the default app for screen casting or media projection.
disable_animations: Globally disables system animations for performance or testing.
force_resizable_activities: Forces all activities to be resizable on large screens.
allow_unsafe_udev: Allows unsafe USB vendor device access (OEM-specific).
use_fbe: Enables File‑Based Encryption for the device storage.
system_user_name: Sets the name displayed for the primary system user.
nav_bar_hide_on_scroll: Hides the navigation bar when scrolling.
nav_bar_immersive_mode: Keeps navigation bar hidden during immersive content.
show_system_ui_on_startup: Shows or hides system UI elements when the device boots.
notification_sound: Specifies the default sound played for notifications.
ringtone: Specifies the default ringtone for incoming calls.
alarm_alert: Specifies the default sound played for alarms.
media_volume: Controls the volume level for media playback.
call_volume: Controls the volume level for voice calls.
ring_volume: Controls the volume level for ring tones.
system_volume: Controls the volume level for system sounds.
tts_default_rate: Sets the default speech rate for text‑to‑speech.
tts_default_pitch: Sets the default pitch for text‑to‑speech.
do_not_disturb_enabled: Enables Do Not Disturb mode to silence notifications.
zen_mode: Configures Do Not Disturb behavior (priority only, alarms only, total silence).
screen_pinning_enabled: Allows screen pinning to lock the focus on a single app.
screen_projection_enabled: Allows screen projection (casting) to external displays.
quick_settings_columns: Sets the number of columns in the Quick Settings panel (OEM-specific).
quick_settings_rows: Sets the number of rows in the Quick Settings panel (OEM-specific).
quick_settings_custom_tiles: Enables custom user‑added tiles in Quick Settings.
ui_mode_night: Force the UI to night mode regardless of system settings.
ui_mode_car: Force the UI to car mode (Android Auto).
ui_mode_desktop: Force the UI to desktop mode (e.g., ChromeOS).
android_id: Unique identifier for the device used by apps.
serial_number: Hardware serial number of the device.
device_provisioned: Indicates whether the device has completed initial provisioning.
setup_wizard_complete: Marks the setup wizard as completed.
user_setup_complete: Indicates that a user has completed device setup.
show_password: Shows the password in clear text when typing (debugging).
hide_sensitive_info: Obscures sensitive information on the lock screen.
developer_option_show_all_aps: Shows all apps in the Developer options list.
global_action_sound_enabled: Enables sound feedback for global actions (e.g., power menu).
accessibility_display_magnification_enab: Enables magnification of the display for accessibility.
accessibility_speech_feedback_enabled: Provides spoken feedback for UI actions.
accessibility_high_contrast_text_enabled: Enables high‑contrast text for better readability.
accessibility_large_text_enabled: Enables larger text size for accessibility.
accessibility_enabled: Globally enables or disables accessibility services.
settings_secure_camera_launch_gesture: Disables or enables the lock‑screen camera launch gesture (OEM‑specific).
settings_secure_quick_settings_tile: Enables or disables specific quick‑settings tiles for security (OEM‑specific).
samsung_smart_view_enabled: Enables Samsung Smart View screen mirroring.
samsung_multi_window_enabled: Enables multi‑window mode on Samsung devices.
miui_perf_mode: Sets performance mode on Xiaomi/Redmi devices (PowerSaving, Normal, Performance).
miui_float_window_permission: Controls permission for floating windows on MIUI.
miui_auto_start_permission: Controls auto‑start permission for apps on MIUI.
miui_privacy_guard: Enables MIUI Privacy Guard to restrict app permissions.
oneplus_game_mode: Enables Game Mode on OnePlus devices to optimize performance.
oneplus_quick_app_switcher: Enables fast app switching on OnePlus devices.
oneplus_super_resolution: Enables super‑resolution display mode on OnePlus devices.
oppo_color_os_floating_window: Controls floating window permission on Oppo/Realme ColorOS.
oppo_lock_screen_notif_show: Shows or hides notifications on the lock screen on Oppo devices.
lg_edge_screen_enabled: Enables Edge Screen feature on LG devices.
lg_notifications_dnd_exceptions: Manages Do Not Disturb exception apps on LG devices.
google_assistant_enabled: Enables or disables Google Assistant integration.
google_vr_mode_enabled: Enables or disables VR Mode for Google Cardboard.
pixel_tap_and_go: Enables Tap & Go feature on Pixel devices.
